segments.title: an animal sees a home
segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment proposed independently by Codex (gpt-6-astra), Tibetan-first. The first gnas is the perceived dwelling (place to stay); the second supplies home within the residence predicate gnas par byed pa. Byed pa supplies the light verb makes in that idiom, without claiming the supplied possessor his. Blos is kept whole, including its inseparable instrumental ending, in the verbal recast thinks. De nyid is pronominal this same; water resolves the preceding row's referent and is unwrapped. The established enumeration la sogs pas licenses or such, including or; pas is not split. The first la, kyi and par are omitted as distributed grammatical relations. Final dang connects onward to the humans of C05:251 and is not assigned the English interior and. An, on the other hand, of, as a, his and there remain unwrapped. No new erratum is proposed; source remains verbatim.
